capability_threshold: ALL neural AND deployed: IID>=.95, OOD>=.90, length16>=.90; stable set may lose admitted tasks; do not replace by deployed-only count
observed_boundary: All deployed seen-task IID/OOD/L16 accuracy=1, but old neural accuracy falls. Strict frozen success accounting yields Qstable=1 throughout and undefined marginal successful retained capability ratios after stage0.
timing_scope: Training is CUDA-synchronized parameter-update block; guard separate; evaluation separate; phase wall includes these plus formation/checkpoint/reload and logging. Geometry costs are cumulative on the evolving model, not extra additive phase costs.
serialization_scope: model_extra JSON counts from inert restricted pickle data parsing; compact sorted UTF-8 duplicates shared references by value; not Python RAM or minimum encoding. Full checkpoint includes metadata, model, optimizer and RNG; caches report overlapping components.
